scope: fafstmobel DFlash2-15 with verify trees and K8V4 on one RTX 5090: GDN verify blocks overlapped on a concurrent compute stream (c6ab440), then the recurrence beside the output-gate projection, a three-stage output-gate stream, a smaller record-kernel footprint and a staged replay fold (e5ed41c). Every state, record and output is bit-identical to bf3bd22.
hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 32 GB at the 575 W power limit; the desktop (Hyprland) shares the GPU, so builds alternate within every round and ratios are paired per round.

bench.method: ninfer_bench on the bench corpus (corpus_262144.ids), greedy, 256 generated tokens, --verify-tree, optimized proposal head, K8V4, max context 139264, four rounds alternating bf3bd22, c6ab440 and e5ed41c; paired median of per-round ratios.
bench.corpus_note: The corpus repeats a small set of paragraphs: 24 of 36 rounds at 8K and every round at 32K and 131K are lookup rounds.

second_pass_only.note: e5ed41c against c6ab440 in the same runs

serving.method: ninfer-serve, max concurrency 1, max context 32768, no prefix reuse, --verify-tree; server restarted per variant; 16 thinking-mode coding chats (seeds 1 and 2) and copy-heavy file edits (seeds 7 and 8), two rounds alternating bf3bd22 and e5ed41c.

sampling.note: Seeded default sampling. Outputs are byte-identical between the builds, so both served the same tokens in the same rounds.

profile.gdn_block_8k_us: nsys, one lookup round: output projection starts 1.4-1.7 us earlier per GDN block once z follows its query/key/value rows on the compute stream (eager launches paid about 2 us per cross-stream wait); graph-launched drafter rounds gain about 0.4 us per block from the three-stage output-gate stream.
profile.fold_us: Lookup rounds at 131K: verification started about 290 us after the round began instead of 395 us once the fold was staged; drafter-round folds at 8K took 184-501 us before and 217-292 us after.
profile.record_kernel: 142 registers and 9056 bytes of shared memory per block, down from 145 and 25312.

losslessness.op_tests: ninfer_gated_delta_net_replay_record_test (fails when the rebuilt query scale is perturbed by one ulp), ninfer_gdn_replay_fold_test, ninfer_gdn_record_overlap_test and ninfer_gdn_input_proj_conv_record_test pass bit for bit.
losslessness.real_test: ninfer_qwen3_5_dflash2_real_test passes chain and tree at B=1 graph, B=8 graph and B=2 eager with unchanged acceptance (20/24, 21/23, 20/24, 20/24).
losslessness.greedy_serving: 32 greedy chats and 8 greedy edits are byte-identical to bf3bd22.
losslessness.ctest: Passes except ninfer_chat_templates_test, which needs jinja2.

rejected: Output-gate projection with 16-row tiles (384 blocks): +1.2 us per GDN block
Output-gate projection with 64-row tiles and four stages: +0.3 us per GDN block
Output-gate projection with four stages or 512-byte K tiles: its blocks crowd out the recurrence (+2 us in a microbenchmark)
Query/key/value projection with three stages: no gain beside the control dots
Stream priorities or launch order between the output-gate projection and the recurrence: no change
